positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Create queries, stored procedures, functions and packages as the backend for web API calls for use in our Central Web Applications.
Created REST APIs for integrations.
Created API interface using Amazon AWS.
positions.insights: Skills: PL/SQL · Strategic Thinking · Oracle Database · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · XML · Systems Analysis · JSON · Jira · API Development

positions.title: Senior Systems Analyst/Team Leader
positions.description:
Assisted in the development and maintenance of a Salon software system using Visual Basic 6.0 and Oracle.
Team leader of a project to upgrade Visual Basic 6.0 code to VB.NET.
Used Crystal Reports create custom reports for software users.
Promoted to Development Manager and team leader of 3-8 programmers. Responsibilities include review of specifications, development of timelines, code reviews and guidance for programmers.
positions.insights: Skills: Database Systems · Strategic Thinking · Research and Development (R&D) · Programming · Software Maintenance · XML · Visual Basic · Crystal Reports · Systems Analysis · Code Review

positions.title: Programmer/Analyst
positions.description:
Developed and maintained a Case Management System for the City Court System using ASP, VBScript, JavaScript and SQL Server.
Worked on a team that developed a Case Management System for the Louisiana Supreme Court using C#, ASP.NET and Oracle.
Assisted in the development of a VB6/SQL Server application to manage a parish Civil Sheriffs office.
Developed a mobile application in ASP.NET and C# for delivery drivers to email in forms to the home office.
positions.insights: Skills: Microsoft SQL Server · Database Systems · Strategic Thinking · Mobile Application Development · ASP.NET · Case Management · Visual Basic · Case Management Software · Systems Analysis

positions.title: Systems Analyst
positions.description:
Developed and maintained a Medical Practice Management System using VBScript, ASP and SQL Server.
Administered and maintained all company databases.
Created a Medical Claims Processing System to batch and send HIPAA compliant claims to multiple payers.
Oversaw a team of seven programmers in the development of an Electronic Medical Record using Microsoft’s.NET programming languages.
Oversaw a team of three programmers in the development of a stand alone Practice Management System using C# and ASP.NET.
Oversaw a team of two programmers in the development of Document Management System using C# and ASP.NET.
As Vice President of Research and Development, oversaw the development and deployment of all MD Technologies software products as well as advanced research into the company’s future products.
positions.insights: Skills: Database Systems · Strategic Thinking · Research and Development (R&D) · Practice Management · ASP.NET · Medical Claims Processing · .NET Framework · Medical Practice Management

positions.title: Senior Systems Analyst/Database Administrator
positions.description:
Assisted in the development and maintenance of a Salon software system using Visual Basic versions 4.0, 5.0, and 6.0.
Lead programmer in the enhancement of SalonBiz into a new product called SpaBiz.
Communicated with head of Estee Lauder conversion division to move ten Spas located across the country to SpaBiz
Used Microsoft Access versions 95, 97, and 2000 as the back end for SalonBiz and SpaBiz.
Converted SalonBiz software into a Client/Server application to allow large salons to use other databases including SQL Server and Oracle.
Trained customers throughout the U.S. on the benefits and use of SalonBiz software.
Performed Database Administration on company databases including Progress, SQL Server, and Access.
Used the Progress 4GL on a UNIX based system to maintain Neill Corporation accounting, payroll, general ledger, and order entry systems.
positions.insights: Skills: Database Systems · Strategic Thinking · Microsoft Access · Progress 4GL · SQL Database Administration · Progress Notes · Oracle Applications · Software Maintenance · New Product Qualification · .NET Framework · Visual Basic · Systems Analysis

positions.title: Air Transportation Specialist
positions.description:
Assisted in the scheduling of airfreights to and from their destinations.
Worked in loading areas to insure proper loading/unloading of hazardous materials.
Ensured proper tie down of air cargo aboard C-130 Cargo planes.
positions.insights: Skills: Strategic Thinking · Air Freight · Systems Analysis · Hazardous Materials Management · C-130

positions.title: Computer Operator
positions.description:
•	Provided secure and highly classified voice communications for Air Base,
•	Installed and maintained remote hookups to Air Base computer systems.
•	Worked as a Communications Operator and dispatched maintenance to remote sites.
•	Maintained the SPERRY 2200/400 base computer system mainframe using standard remote terminals.
•	Assisted in providing security for camp and communications tent.
•	Assisted in instructing soldiers in the proper use of chemical protection equipment in case of emergencies.
